Current ClinicalImpression source has no investigation element and its supportingInfo definition includes the investigation-results clarification, but active FHIR ModelInfo still contained ClinicalImpression.investigation and ClinicalImpression.Investigation.
additional_context: FHIR-18860 was discovered through the same original application commit as the seed. Later FHIR-50411 resolved no-change on adding DiagnosticReport-like supportingInfo structure, and FHIR-50409 is a later change-required wording/basis cleanup; neither reinstates ClinicalImpression.investigation. A Zulip implementers thread also confirmed investigation was dropped in R5 with J#18860.
